title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Booking Terms: Rescheduling an Appointment
content:
**Clause 1 — What a reschedule is.** A Repair Estimates & Appointments reschedule moves the appointment of a booking that has not yet taken place. The booking is in booked status, as the booking record shows.

**Clause 2 — Cutoff.** The reschedule request is made at least the estimate type's reschedule cutoff hours before the scheduled appointment start. The appointment start is the appointment date at the appointment slot in the repair center's local time; the cutoff is that start minus the cutoff hours, counted in full 60-minute hours, and a request exactly at the cutoff is in time.

**Clause 3 — Number of reschedules.** The number of reschedules already on the booking must be below the number of reschedules the estimate type permits per booking; once the limit is reached no further reschedule is recorded and the customer may instead cancel and make a new booking.

**Clause 4 — The new date.** The new date must also sit inside the estimate type's booking window, counted from the reschedule request date.

**Clause 5 — Record.** Each reschedule records the next reschedule number (1 for the first) and replaces the appointment date and slot on the booking.

**Clause 6 — Photo Estimate.** A Photo Estimate has no appointment to move; its photo window is never extended by a reschedule.

### Cutoff examples (hypothetical appointments)

| Estimate type (cutoff) | Appointment start | Cutoff | Request at | In time? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Estimate (24 hours) | Thursday 10:00 | Wednesday 10:00 | Wednesday 10:00 | Yes, exactly at the cutoff |
| Mobile Estimate (24 hours) | Thursday 10:00 | Wednesday 10:00 | Wednesday 10:01 | No |
| Drive-In Estimate (2 hours) | Friday 14:30 | Friday 12:30 | Friday 12:00 | Yes |

### Count example

A hypothetical Scheduled Estimate booking (2 reschedules permitted) already carrying reschedules number 1 and 2 has reached the limit: a third reschedule is not recorded, and the customer may instead cancel and make a new booking. The same booking carrying only reschedule number 1 may take reschedule number 2, if the cutoff and the new date's booking window are also met.
